_comment: Character cards (three-tier model — see the-character-model.md). Data only; effects live in verbs.py. Every number here is balance config.

colours._note: Wheel order W-U-B-R-G. shard = centre + two wings.

_units_note: Two currencies, one per green edge (see the-character-model.md / unit-economy-edges). supporters = G-W community (soft STOCK, fuels edicts); zealots = G-R authenticity (hard FLOW, spent on direct board actions). No soldiers. A character can grow a currency only if its shard touches that currency's edge: White (GWU) has no R, so it can NEVER muster zealots — pacifism is a hole in the shard.
_verbs_note: Which colours grant each shared (tier-3) verb. A character can use a verb if any of its colours is in the character's shard. Signature verbs are NOT here — they are granted only to their owner. muster_zealots is Red's signature (its colours are advisory only — availability comes from being the signature). rally_supporters (G-W) and muster_zealots (G-R) are the two unit verbs; strike (R) spends zealots.

unit_yield._note: How many units each unit verb produces (before decree deltas).

_decrees_note: Decrees are RULES on the table that hook the verb pipeline (see decrees.py). A decree may MATCH a verb (+optional detail), apply an ambient EFFECT (cost/yield delta), OFFER a RIDER (the 'may' — the acting player chooses), and SCORE its owner on 'compliance' (rider taken) or 'always'. White's legitimacy = skimming Mandate off others living under its rules. NOTE: unit-yield deltas target a specific verb via trigger.on (rally_supporters vs muster_zealots), since the two currencies are now distinct verbs.

civic_endowment.text: When any player draws a card, they may draw +1. If they do, White scores 1.

academic_census.text: When a RESEARCH card is drawn, that player may draw +1. If they do, White scores 2. (Hits Blue often, Green never — wheel-targeting via wording.)

open_records.text: When any player rallies supporters, they get +1 supporter. White scores 1 each time. (A boon the table wants; White skims legitimacy off community growth. Targets the G-W edge — White's own home edge.)

martial_restraint.text: Ambient: strikes cost +1 zealot. (A tax on the militant G-R edge — no rider, no compliance skim. The structurally-pacifist White taxing Red's verb.)

writ_of_order.text: Ambient: mustering zealots yields -1. (A tax on militarization.)

public_works.text: When any player rallies supporters, White scores 1 (no effect on the rally itself).
